description: Minimum required response columns for the public OSE events API. Removing any field from projected_columns MUST be accompanied by removing it here and bumping the version — that makes the change visible in a diff rather than silent. Adding new fields is always safe (additive). Computed fields are those injected by enrichWithPhase() at the handler layer, not projected from the DB SELECT. v1.1.0 (OSE-844/ADR-016): enrichWithPhase now also emits the canonical field names name/startDateISO/venue (mapped from the title/start_date/location columns) so every surface template reads one name per value — see computed_fields.
